checkpointScenarios.title: Managed Browser Exact URL And Active Tab Proof
realEvidencePath: Start the Rust agent from the current commit.
Launch an Ocentra-managed browser profile through the documented product or dev path.
Open a known URL in the managed profile and request browser evidence through the service path.
Verify exact URL, title, normalized domain, managed profile state, and active-tab certainty or explicit tab-list-only state.
requiredArtifacts: Commit SHA and platform name.
Managed browser proof JSON from test-results or copied service diagnostics.
Rust service log snippet showing the managed browser evidence request.
Parent-visible diagnostic output or screenshot showing the same evidence.
knownGaps: Hosted CI can prove managed-profile launch mechanics but not a household managed-browser session.
Active foreground tab certainty must remain unknown or tab-list-only when CDP targets cannot prove foreground focus.
notProof: A browser process name without URL/title evidence.
A URL typed directly into a test fixture or portal-local state.
Evidence from a default or unmanaged personal browser profile.

checkpointScenarios.title: Foreground Process And Window Proof
realEvidencePath: Start the Rust agent on a Windows host from the current commit.
Bring a known application window to the foreground.
Request process/window activity through the service or parent surface.
Verify foreground app/window identity, process snapshot state, observation mode, and degraded status when no active window is available.
requiredArtifacts: Commit SHA and Windows build.
Rust service log snippet showing process/window observation.
Copied parent diagnostic output or screenshot showing the foreground observation.
Name of the real foreground application used during the run.
knownGaps: Hosted CI cannot certify real Windows foreground-window capture.
Non-Windows hosts must report typed unavailable or not-applicable states.
notProof: A hardcoded process/window row inserted into SQLite.
A portal-only label that is not returned by the Rust service.
A snapshot-only observation presented as active foreground-window proof.

checkpointScenarios.title: Network And Domain Attribution Proof
realEvidencePath: Start the Rust agent on a real host while normal network activity is generated.
Request network/domain flow evidence through the service path.
Verify destination domain or endpoint, process attribution when available, unknown attribution when not available, and no decrypted payload capture.
Record degraded states for VPN, proxy, permission, or OS visibility limits.
requiredArtifacts: Commit SHA and platform name.
Rust service log snippet showing the network evidence query.
Copied parent diagnostic output or screenshot showing domains or endpoint summaries.
Description of the real network action used to generate the flow.
knownGaps: Administrator, kernel, VPN, driver, or packet visibility cannot be certified by hosted CI.
Unknown process or domain attribution must stay explicitly unknown rather than being inferred.
notProof: A manually inserted domain row.
A packet payload or decrypted HTTPS content claim.
A process-to-domain association invented by test code.

checkpointScenarios.title: App And Game Duration Proof
realEvidencePath: Run a known app or game while the Rust agent is active.
Let the app remain active long enough to produce first-seen and last-seen evidence.
Request app/game session evidence from the real service path.
Verify duration, foreground time where available, executable/app identity, source evidence ids, and unknown classification boundaries.
requiredArtifacts: Commit SHA and platform name.
Rust service log snippet showing app/game session query.
Copied parent diagnostic output or screenshot showing duration evidence.
Observed wall-clock start and stop times for the manual run.
knownGaps: Long-running app/game behavior requires a real host over time.
Unknown or ambiguous app classification must not be upgraded to game evidence without stored support.
notProof: Duration calculated from a portal timer only.
AI-guessed app/game classification without stored evidence references.
A manually inserted session summary row.

checkpointScenarios.title: Screen Evidence Queue Proof
realEvidencePath: Enable the supported local screen evidence setting on a real host.
Start the Rust agent from the current commit.
Request screen evidence queue state through the service path.
Verify permission, disabled, queued, summarized, deletion, and degraded states without exposing raw screenshots by default.
requiredArtifacts: Commit SHA and platform permission state.
Rust service log snippet showing screen evidence queue state.
Copied parent diagnostic output or screenshot showing queue state.
Queue state before and after one supported local screen evidence action.
knownGaps: Hosted CI cannot grant or certify screen recording permissions.
Permission-limited hosts must report typed unavailable or permission-required states.
notProof: A screenshot file placed directly in a test directory.
A queue summary not produced by the Rust service or product state path.
A raw screen capture claim without permission and deletion-state evidence.

checkpointScenarios.title: Local And LAN Smoke Proof
realEvidencePath: Build contracts and the Rust service.
Run localhost smoke against the real Rust service.
Run LAN bind and origin smoke against the real Rust service.
Confirm the smoke uses managed ports and does not accept an unrelated stale service.
requiredArtifacts: CI or local smoke log showing websocket-local-smoke-ok.
CI or local smoke log showing websocket-lan-smoke-ok.
Command output naming the commit under test.
knownGaps: Single-machine LAN bind smoke is not proof of household multi-device pairing.
Pairing, trusted-device registry, and remote routing remain later milestones.
notProof: A Vite-only portal run without the Rust service.
A stale process on the expected port that was not launched by the test.
A cloud or relay path presented as LAN pairing proof.

checkpointScenarios.title: Package Installed Service And Autostart Gap Tracking
realEvidencePath: Build package previews for each runner family.
Run package launch or install smoke where the runner supports it.
Record which platforms have mechanical package proof only.
Keep installed service autostart, signing, store, notarization, and device-owner proof out of completed runtime claims until real host/device artifacts exist.
requiredArtifacts: Package preview job logs for each platform family.
Installer or launch-smoke output where available.
Explicit gap note for service autostart, signing, notarization, stores, device-owner mode, and TestFlight.
knownGaps: Preview packaging is not production signing or store distribution.
Installed Windows service autostart is not proven until an installed package is exercised on a real host.
Android device-owner and iOS entitlement behavior remain unproven until real device or approved entitlement proof exists.
notProof: A successful archive build presented as installed service autostart.
A simulator launch presented as device-owner, TestFlight, or entitlement proof.
Unsigned preview artifacts presented as production release readiness.

claims.claim: Repository, TypeScript/Rust contracts, service/portal scaffold, validation, CI, and package-preview foundation exist.
knownGaps: Package-preview launch smoke is not store signing, notarization, or managed-device proof.

claims.claim: Encrypted journal, replay, SQLite ingest/query, service status, and portal visibility use real storage code paths.
knownGaps: Mobile storage parity is package/runtime compatibility proof until mobile parent/child data flows exist.

claims.roadmapSlice: V0.3 Windows Process And Window Activity Capture
claims.claim: Windows process/window observations are captured, stored, queried, and visible through the parent portal.
knownGaps: Hosted CI can prove service/UI mechanics but not real foreground-window capture on a parent-approved child PC.
manualProofChecklist: Launch the Rust agent on Windows with the current commit.
Request process/window activity from the parent portal.
Verify returned activity matches real running processes or foreground window state.
Capture portal diagnostics and Rust logs with the commit SHA.

claims.roadmapSlice: V0.4 Windows Network And Domain Observation
claims.claim: Network/domain and flow summaries are represented, persisted, queried, and shown without decrypted payload claims.
knownGaps: Admin, kernel, driver, VPN, or OS-specific network visibility requires real host/device proof.
manualProofChecklist: Run the agent on Windows while generating normal network activity.
Request network flow evidence from the parent portal.
Verify domains, endpoints, unknown attribution, and no-content-inspection boundaries.
Capture portal diagnostics and Rust logs with the commit SHA.

claims.claim: The parent portal sends real typed requests to the Rust service and renders validated service state.
knownGaps: Mobile parent app parity is not claimed by the current Vite development portal.

claims.roadmapSlice: V0.5.1 Browser URL And Tab Evidence Capture
claims.claim: Managed browser URL/tab evidence and unmanaged/degraded states are typed, stored, queried, and visible.
knownGaps: Existing personal browser profiles/tabs are not proven unless the managed-browser boundary produces real evidence.
manualProofChecklist: Launch the managed browser path from the app or documented dev command.
Open a known URL and request browser evidence from the parent portal.
Verify URL, title/domain, managed/unmanaged state, and stale/degraded states are real.
Capture portal diagnostics and Rust logs with the commit SHA.

claims.roadmapSlice: V0.5.2 App And Game Evidence Sessions
claims.claim: App/game session summaries use stored activity evidence rather than portal state or AI guesses.
knownGaps: Long-running real app/game behavior needs host-specific observation over time.
manualProofChecklist: Run a known app or game on Windows while the agent is active.
Request app/game session evidence from the parent portal.
Verify running time, foreground time, first/last seen, and source evidence refs.
Capture portal diagnostics and Rust logs with the commit SHA.

claims.roadmapSlice: V0.5.3 Local Screen Evidence Analysis Queue
claims.claim: Screen evidence queue/read-model state is typed, local-only, parent-visible, and honest about disabled or permission-limited capture.
knownGaps: Real screen capture and permission prompts cannot be certified by hosted CI.
manualProofChecklist: Enable the supported local screen evidence setting on a real host.
Request screen evidence state from the parent portal.
Verify permission, queue, deletion, summary, and disabled/degraded states are real.
Capture portal diagnostics and Rust logs with the commit SHA.

claims.roadmapSlice: V0.6 Local AI Safety Decision Contracts
claims.claim: Local AI, policy, runtime, parent-rule, and evidence-reference contracts reject invalid or degraded states before enforcement.
knownGaps: Contracts are not model execution or enforcement proof.

claims.claim: Dry-run policy preview reads stored evidence references and parent rules through typed service/API paths with enforcement disabled.
knownGaps: V0.7 remains dry-run; enforcement adapters and real model execution are not claimed.

claims.claim: Preview artifacts build and install or launch-smoke on the target runner family without claiming stores, signing, or privileged capture.
knownGaps: Preview packaging is not production signing, app store, TestFlight, notarization, or device-owner proof.
